purpose: Product-page tab strip listing the five products (Find, Connect, Sell, Manage, Foundation) with the current one highlighted by its brand-colour dot, so visitors can move between product pages.

variants.name: desktop-tab-bar
variants.description: lg and up: five equal-width tabs, 48px tall, 2px apart; the active one is a plain span on gray-2 with a colour dot, the others are links on gray-3 with a dimmed placeholder square. Sticky under the navbar from md.

variants.name: mobile-current-chip
variants.description: Below lg: a single half-width chip on gray-2 showing only the current product name and dot; no way to switch tabs from this strip.

dot.note: Colour class per product: find, connect, sell, manage, foundation in that order.

tabs.note: Fixed list PRODUCT_TABS; not overridable per page.

behaviour.note: Inactive tabs are plain anchors (full page load), not router links.
Sticky: from md the bar is `sticky` at the navbar height with z-40, under the z-50 navbar. It is only rendered visible at lg+.

motion.reducedMotionNote: Proposal only: no prefers-reduced-motion handling. Tab background and text colour transition over 200ms on hover; the active dot pops in on mount (opacity 0 and scale .75 to 1, 200ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)).

changes.change: tab bar hidden; half-width current-product chip shown instead
tab bar becomes sticky below the navbar (only visible from lg)
